assumptions.statement_zh: 官方控规指标（FAR/高度/密度/绿地率/退线）缺失，相关指标标 unknown，待正式规划条件。
assumptions.statement_en: Official regulatory controls (FAR/height/density/green ratio/setback) are absent; related metrics are marked unknown pending formal planning conditions.

assumptions.statement_zh: site/key-area 几何为 provisional，置信度 medium，official 数据发布后全包重算。
assumptions.statement_en: Site and key-area geometries are provisional at medium confidence; the whole package is recalculated once official data is published.

assumptions.statement_zh: provisional 复算面积与公告数值存在差异，两者不可互相替代。
assumptions.statement_en: Provisional recalculated areas differ from announced values; the two must not substitute for each other.

assumptions.statement_zh: 未踏勘，现状判断基于公告、任务书与公开资料。
assumptions.statement_en: No site visit was conducted; current-condition judgments rely on the announcement, task book, and public materials.

assumptions.statement_zh: 场景基线/阈值均为设计建议目标值，现场基线待落地采集（unknown 表达）。
assumptions.statement_en: Scenario baselines and thresholds are design-suggested target values; field baselines await on-site collection and are expressed as unknown.

assumptions.statement_zh: 全部空间/活动/政策建议为概念建议，不构成政府审定或实施承诺。
assumptions.statement_en: All spatial, activity, and policy proposals are concept suggestions and do not constitute government review conclusions or implementation commitments.

assumptions.statement_zh: 用户画像为典型角色合成样本，用于设计校验而非实测数据。
assumptions.statement_en: User personas are synthesized typical-role samples for design validation, not measured data.

assumptions.statement_zh: 用地与建筑体量为概念建议，待官方边界与规划条件确认后重算。
assumptions.statement_en: Land use and building massing are concept suggestions to be recalculated after official boundaries and planning conditions are confirmed.

assumptions.statement_zh: 验证协议目标值（响应时间/通过率等）为运营设计目标，非已实现指标。
assumptions.statement_en: Protocol target values (response time, pass rates, etc.) are operational design goals, not achieved indicators.

assumptions.statement_zh: 场景数据遵循数据最小化，不采集个人可识别行为画像，删除凭证设计参照生成式 AI 管理办法第 14/15 条边界。
assumptions.statement_en: Scenario data follows data minimization without identifiable behavioral profiling; deletion-receipt design follows Articles 14/15 boundaries of the Generative AI Interim Measures.
